evidence_slice: City of York Council adopted the City of York Local Plan on 27 February 2025. Policy SS11 identifies Land North of Haxby (ST9) as an urban extension expected to deliver approximately 735 dwellings. The adopted-plan housing-allocation table records ST9, Land North of Haxby, at 35.0 hectares and 735 homes. City of York Council's public LocalPlanPoliciesMap service is the adopted policies map and exposes the Spatial Strategy (areas) layer as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer; the layer lists Land North of Haxby and includes fields for Local Plan Site reference and Local Plan Policy reference.
binding_method: adopted Local Plan strategic housing allocation plus authority-hosted polygon-capable GIS layer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official council plan page, plan text and GIS service were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file bytes and the exact ST9 feature geometry payload were not acquired, so no source-file hash or polygon coordinates are fabricated.
license: City of York Council public adopted-plan documents and public ArcGIS service; layer-specific reuse licence not stated in the public service metadata.
